name: [WIP] PASADA: Jeepney Legends
desc:
Manibela Kings [BETA]

🚧 The game is temporarily CLOSED for our Beta overhaul. Join our community server below for dev logs, testing announcements, and updates!

Experience the authentic daily hustle of Philippine transit. Drive iconic public utility jeepneys, master the highways of South Luzon, or commute as a passenger in a living regional economy.

🛺 UPCOMING BETA FEATURES:
• Authentic handling with custom manual/automatic physics
• Makiling Corridor: Calamba, Sto. Tomas & Tanauan arterial routes
• Interactive Passenger AI: hailing, dynamic seating, roadside animations
• Manual fare collection & accurate distance-based change calculations
• Rent-to-Own boundary progression & garage customization
• Real-time signboard routing & GPS navigation

⚠️ Note: Manibela Kings is in active development. Expect regular balance tuning, optimizations, and new corridors!
